name: Movie Engine – OTT Streaming Platform for Movies & TV Series
author: Themepul

sections.description:
Movie Engine is a complete OTT streaming and video-on-demand (VOD) plugin for WordPress.

Movie Engine is not just a plugin — it’s a complete OTT ecosystem.
It provides everything you need to build, manage, and scale a professional video streaming platform, including content management, streaming infrastructure, user engagement, and monetization tools — all inside WordPress.

Launch your own streaming platform without complex infrastructure or expensive development.

Create a Netflix-style website with movies, TV series, seasons, and episodes — powered by automatic TMDb metadata import and a professional HLS/DASH-ready video player.

Whether you want to build a movie streaming website, an IPTV platform, a subscription video service, or a pay-per-view portal, Movie Engine provides the structure, performance, and scalability needed to launch a modern video platform.

Why Movie Engine?

✔ Designed for OTT and video streaming websites
✔ One-click TMDb movie & TV series import
✔ Advanced HLS (.m3u8) and DASH video player
✔ Season & episode management system
✔ Watchlist & Continue Watching features
✔ SEO-ready with JSON-LD schema markup
✔ Developer-friendly architecture with hooks & REST API
✔ Built for performance and scalability

Compatibility

Movie Engine works with most modern WordPress themes and page builders.

For the best experience, we recommend using the official Hello Movie Engine theme which is optimized for OTT streaming websites.

What Can You Build?

• Netflix-style streaming website
• Subscription-based video platform (SVOD)
• Pay-per-view movie website (TVOD)
• Ad-supported streaming platform (AVOD)
• TMDb-powered movie & TV database
• IPTV streaming site
• Private video membership portal

Core Features (Free Version)

Movie & TV Library System

  • Custom Post Types for Movies, TV Series, Seasons & Episodes
  • Advanced taxonomies (Genre, Year, Country, Language, Network)
  • Cast & Crew profiles
  • SEO-friendly permalinks

TMDb Smart Import

  • One-click movie import
  • One-click TV series import
  • Auto-fetch posters, backdrops, cast, ratings & trailers
  • Duplicate detection

Advanced OTT Video Player

  • HLS (.m3u8) streaming support
  • MPEG-DASH support
  • MP4 playback
  • Multi-server support
  • Subtitle (.vtt) support
  • Resume playback & quality selector

User Engagement

  • Watchlist
  • Continue Watching
  • Recently Watched
  • User dashboard
  • Rating system

Monetization Ready

  • Display ads integration
  • Affiliate streaming buttons
  • Premium content controls (extended in Pro)

Free vs Pro

Free Version

✔ Full movie & TV series management
✔ TMDb import system
✔ HLS/DASH streaming player
✔ Watchlist & user dashboard
✔ Ads & affiliate integration
✔ SEO schema integration

Pro Version

✔ Subscription system (SVOD)
✔ Pay-Per-View system (TVOD)
✔ Stripe & PayPal integration
✔ Bulk import & automation
✔ Referral system
✔ Advanced monetization controls

Learn more about Pro:

Developer Friendly

  • Namespaced architecture
  • Modular structure
  • Action & filter hooks
  • REST API ready
  • Template override support
  • Headless & mobile app compatible

SEO & Performance

  • Built-in JSON-LD Schema for Movies & TV Series
  • Open Graph support
  • Optimized asset loading

  • Secure and optimized streaming proxy endpoints

sections.installation:
1. Upload the cine-movie-engine folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save once.
  4. Add your TMDb API key under Movie Engine → API Settings.
  5. Start building your streaming library.
sections.faq:
Can I build a Netflix-style website with WordPress?

Yes. Movie Engine provides the full structure for movies, TV series, seasons, and episodes with streaming support.

Does it support HLS streaming?

Yes. The player supports HLS (.m3u8), DASH, and MP4 formats.

Can I create a subscription video platform?

Yes. The Pro version includes subscription and pay-per-view monetization.

Is TMDb import included?

Yes. You can automatically import metadata from TMDb (The Movie Database).

Is it beginner-friendly?

Yes. No coding is required, but developers can extend it.

Is there an official theme for this plugin?

Yes. Hello Movie Engine is the official free theme built for Movie Engine. It provides optimized layouts for movies, TV series, seasons, and episodes, and is designed specifically for OTT streaming websites.

You can install the Hello Movie Engine theme from the WordPress theme directory, or directly from the Theme Marketplace section inside Movie Engine.
